questions.question:
In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

12 ∶ 144

13 ∶ 169
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is,

Logic: **Second Number = (First Number)²**

**12 ∶ 144**

→ 144 = (12)²

**13 ∶ 169**

→ 169 = (13)²

Let's check each option as per the logic,

**1) 9 ∶ 80**

→ 80 ≠ (9)²

**2) 10 ∶ 90**

→ 90 ≠ (10)²

**3) 15 ∶ 225**

→ 225 = (15)² ⇒ **Satisfies 
the logic.**

**4) 14 ∶ 182**

→ 182 ≠ (14)²

Hence, the correct answer is **15 ∶ 225**.

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:** All orchids are flowers. Some orchids are beautiful.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some flowers are beautiful.

(II) All beautiful are flowers.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02ca0351c3cb5a16dbbacecd1b79523fb8e8fcc629e15a83923cb9a685c86cbc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some flowers are beautiful → Follow (As all orchids are flowers and some orchids are beautiful. So, as some part of beautiful is common with orchids which whole comes in flowers therefore it is definitely true)

II. All beautiful are flowers → **Does not **follow (As All orchids are flowers. Some orchids are beautiful. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) is follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion (I) is follows**".
